overview_description.description:
Sellou is a mobile marketplace app that enables users to buy and sell goods locally. It features a user-friendly video interface for listing items, complete with descriptions, photos, and prices. The app includes search and location-based filters to help users find products nearby, promoting local commerce. Buyers and sellers can communicate directly through an in-app messaging system, and a rating system ensures transparency and trust. 
Additionally, the app offers a unique feature for sellers: the ability to manage and schedule posts across multiple social media platforms directly from the app. This helps sellers promote their listings more effectively and reach a broader audience. Designed for individuals and small businesses alike, Sellou is a practical tool for peer-to-peer commerce, available for download on iOS.
